answer: Each agent identity must stake a marble bond of 480 units in a shared registry and bind one hardware credential to one device. Minting a fake identity locks 480 units, forfeits 100 percent on slashing, and waits 30 epochs for withdrawal. Splitting identities costs 480 units each, shares one slashing penalty, and independent jurors in a nebula pool flag duplicates; karst ledgers record each credential.
